title: Public Client Browser Playback Session Identity
problem: Browser playback tickets let the web player start media safely, but the Public Client contract does not expose session identity for heartbeat.
gates: npm --prefix web run test -- src/test/data-source-contracts.test.ts src/test/video-player.test.tsx
evidence: PBSI-010 opened this lane from WDRP-065 after WMLP recorded browser heartbeat/session identity as a Public Client contract gap.
PBSI-020 froze BrowserPlaybackTicketResponse.playback_session_id, non-subtitle ticket/session binding, heartbeat authority, URL/header safety, and SDK expectations.

PBSI-030 implemented the server/API/SDK contract: required nullable playback_session_id, non-subtitle session allocation before ticket response, opaque ticket binding, same-session media requests, subtitle null identity, heartbeat owner/play access, and regenerated TypeScript/Kotlin SDKs.
PBSI-040 wired web playback plans and VideoPlayer heartbeat dispatch through BrowserPlaybackTicketResponse.playback_session_id without parsing media URLs or diagnostic headers.
PBSI-050 closed the lane after final protocol/API/server/web gates and split remaining browser telemetry polish plus native/Tauri playback integration to follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: PBSI is complete. The browser playback session identity contract is shipped across protocol/API/server/SDK/web. Future unload cancellation, richer browser QoE telemetry, and native/Tauri playback integration should open focused follow-on lanes.
